title: DepRisk symbol map (v1)
description: A curated list of the public entry points (symbols) through which application code reaches the flaw of an advisory in a package. Input of 'deprisk reach --symbols'. OSV carries no such data for NuGet or npm, so it has to come from here. See docs/symbol-maps.md.

language.description: csharp: NuGet packages, analyzed as C#. javascript: npm packages, analyzed as JavaScript and TypeScript.

advisory.description: An advisory id or one of its aliases (for example a CVE id); matched ignoring case.

package.description: The package id (NuGet) or npm package name such as lodash or @scope/pkg; matched ignoring case. See 'language' for the allowed characters.

symbols.description: csharp: Namespace.Type.Member, Namespace.Type.#ctor (constructors), or Namespace.Type.* (any member, including constructors). javascript: a path relative to the entry's package (parse, Parser.parse, Parser.*, default, or * for any use of the package) or package::path where the package is the entry's package or a subpath of it (lodash/fp::map).

complete.description: True only if the list is claimed to contain every public way to reach the flaw. Required, no default: without true, a missing path is 'unknown', never 'unreachable'.

source.description: Provenance: who or what says these are the symbols (a reference, a commit, an analyst).
